# Company Introduction and Internship Overview 
---

**Scheduled time:** 10:00 AM–10:15 AM

## Objective

This chapter introduces NTS, the internship programme, and the technologies you will be working with throughout the internship.

## About NTS

NTS develops software solutions that support business operations, digital services, and customer-facing web applications. Our development team works with modern web technologies to build scalable, maintainable, and user-friendly systems.

As an intern, you will become part of the software development team and contribute to real development projects under the guidance of experienced developers.


## Company Projects

### NTS Ecommerce Website

Link <https://ntscomputers.com.my/>

The primary commercial project is the NTS React webshop.

The webshop includes functionality such as:

- product catalogue
- categories
- product search
- shopping cart
- customer accounts
- quotations
- order processing
- inventory integration
- payment integration
- backoffice administration

During the internship you will work on a local development copy of this system.

### N3DS Website

Link <https://react.nts.nl/nts-3d/>

The company maintains the N3DS website using a headless CMS architecture.

The website is built using:

- React
- Directus CMS
- Quarto
- Typst
- Markdown
- REST APIs

The website contains:

- company information
- project portfolio
- technical documentation
- educational material
- product documentation
- academic publications

## Technologies Used

During the internship you will be exposed to the following technologies.

| Technology | Purpose |
|------------|---------|
| React | Frontend web development |
| Directus | Headless Content Management System |
| REST APIs | Communication between frontend and backend |
| Figma | User interface design |
| Git | Version control |
| AI Tools | Code assistance and research |
| Quarto | Technical documentation |

What is mostly important is your willingness to learn, ask questions, and solve problems independently.

## Internship Expectations

During your internship you may be asked to:

- Develop React user interfaces.
- Configure and use Directus.
- Consume and develop REST APIs.
- Convert Figma designs into working web pages.
- Work with Git repositories.
- Use AI tools responsibly to improve productivity.
- Produce clear technical documentation.

Most work will be carried out on a local development environment before changes are reviewed by a supervisor.

## Assessment Overview

This assessment consists of several practical exercises that reflect typical tasks performed during the internship.

The assessment is not intended to test whether you already know everything. Instead, it measures:

- Your problem-solving approach.
- Your ability to understand new technologies.
- Your coding practices.
- Your communication skills.
- Your willingness to learn.

## Handling Errors

When a command fails:

1. Copy the important part of the error.
2. Record it under the related task.
3. Explain what caused the problem.
4. Explain how it was fixed.
5. Add a screenshot when useful.
